The Lisp Machine implementation of COPYTREE only descends through
CONSes.  I am not completely sure what you mean by PAIRs (whether they
might include things other than CONSes), and what should happen in Lisps
that support HUNKs.  But I think that the idea is that it is like SUBST
in this respect.
